verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a public REST API for syncs, models, sources, and destinations, with bearer-token API-key auth and group-scoped keys explicitly suited to AI tools [hightouch-docs-13, hightouch-docs-33, hightouch-docs-50]. Marketing also says syncs can be configured via API, and Git Sync offers programmatic resource management [hightouch-docs-48, hightouch-docs-32]. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), detailed endpoint reference evidence, any evidence that REST covers audiences/journeys rather than only syncs, models, sources and destinations, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.
